description:
We’ll be running the **svg‑patterns** tool with its configuration pointing to the generated file `build/patterns.js`. This is where the compiled SVG pattern script will be written, ready for inclusion in the project.  

The configuration adheres to the JSON Schema located at `http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#` and pulls the raw pattern data from the online gallery at `https://gitcdn.xyz/repo/progers/Patterns-Gallery/master/index.html`.
